199533964928978954:
To $N,

My good Great Hero, You really got the Mystic Bird Pendant?! That Grave of Doubt is incredibly dangerous, how did you manage to make it out alive? You really have become an incredible hero now! Tell me, were you hurt at all? Traveling alone… you must not push yourself too hard.

All these years, I've always wondered—who could possibly bring out the Mystic Bird Pendant from that man-eating Grave of Doubt? Never did I imagine it would be you! But thinking about it now, it's no surprise. Once you set your mind to something, you never let go—just like how you insisted on helping everyone in the Forsaken Quarter, never once thinking of giving up. In that way, you really do resemble my uncle.

In his final years, Uncle devoted himself to finding someone like him to inherit Weiyang City. For that, he even broke tradition and allowed me to undergo the same training as his children. I was able to surpass my cousins only because my determination was stronger—I needed the title of City Lord more than any of them in order to lift my mother out of her suffering.

I don't think I've ever told you about my real mother. She was a wonderful, wonderful woman. Ever since I was young, I believed she deserved a better life—one of splendor in Weiyang City, instead of this small, suffocating courtyard, filled with humiliation. In the end, I wasn't a good enough daughter. And I couldn't bring her back to the life she should have had...

But enough of that. Oh, before Uncle passed away, he told me there were two people in this world who resembled him. One was me, the other was the one who would someday carry out the Mystic Bird Pendant. He never lived to meet the second, but I have. It's a pleasure to truly meet you—the one in this world most like me. I only hope… you will never become my enemy.
